hypothesis: Four-beat encounters can retain owner-endorsed visual appeal while making counters, rules and consequences readable across varied compositions. Radical peak alternatives test excitement versus causal clarity without selecting canon.

entries.title: Measure the blade
entries.caption: Riven offers a low opening and waits for metal to meet metal.
entries.brief: Both adults full figures several steps apart across the bridge terrace. Riven feints a low saber threat toward Vey's forward foot, looking at her hands. Vey lowers the glaive to meet it, rear hand ready to drive the haft. Blade tips just touch: a narrow cyan contact, no hit flare, no airborne body. Establish readable faces, space and the arch/parapet landmarks.

power.name: Borrowed Beat
power.description: A metal parry stores a short impulse, released through the next weapon contact.
power.limitation: Only one contact can hold the charge; the injured supporting arm stays injured.
power.growth: Learn to release a smaller pulse early to interrupt a counter instead of waiting for a finishing blow.

entries.title: The counter arrives first
entries.caption: Vey attacks the arm supporting his guard before he can spend the stored force.
entries.brief: Dangerously close view from behind Vey's near shoulder. Vey drives the blunt middle of her glaive shaft into Riven's LEFT forearm as he tries to guard his ribs; his supporting arm folds across his torso and his face recoils. His RIGHT hand still holds the single saber low across frame, cyan edge storing the earlier parry. Crack the left forearm armor at this contact, a few large chips only. Show contact/strained face/continuous glaive and both of Vey's grips; intentional limb cropping allowed, no duplicate hands.

entries.title: Return through the bind
entries.caption: He spends the parry through her weapon and turns the counter against her.
entries.brief: Riven drops to one knee under the glaive, cracked LEFT forearm close to his ribs. His RIGHT saber presses sharply upward against the middle of Vey's glaive with a concentrated cyan-white contact. This rotates her own haft back into her upper chest/shoulder: compressed expression, shoulder raised, torso turning, one heel skidding but no floating body. Her near hand loses its grip while her far hand still reaches along the same continuous shaft. Dominant diagonal blade/haft/body reaction; environment broad and subordinate.

entries.title: The price stays
entries.caption: The opening is won; the injured arm will shape the next exchange.
entries.brief: Aftermath on the same terrace. Riven kneels in foreground, saber in RIGHT hand with cyan edge now dim, inspecting his cracked LEFT forearm armor with a strained half-smile. Vey is seated against the low parapet several paces away, winded but alert; her glaive lies intact on the ground between them, clear ownership. No strike effects, no victory pose. Large quiet spaces and long shadows; both people still recognizable.

entries.title: The body ignores steel
entries.caption: The armor barely notices the blade. Something beneath it carries the weight.
entries.brief: Mael in RIGHT foreground draws her estoc back after a shallow scratch on an ivory supporting limb; the mark is tiny, the towering creature barely reacts. Its black load-bearing shadow-tendon visibly runs taut across a bright strip of stone toward a planted broad claw at LEFT. Mael's eye follows that dark tendon rather than the mask. Full dramatic creature/character size relation and readable path underfoot, no busy veins.

power.name: Sever the Support
power.description: A precise estoc cut severs a load-bearing shadow while it crosses lit stone.
power.limitation: The exposed shadow can be covered by the creature's claw; slashing armored petals does nothing.
power.growth: Identify which shadow carries weight while the creature changes its stance.

entries.title: It hides the weakness
entries.caption: It covers the shadow—and nearly catches her with it.
entries.brief: The creature's broad ivory claw SLAMS down over the lit shadow-tendon. Mael bends sideways narrowly beneath its sweeping wrist, her face close enough to show alarm and calculation. Estoc stays in RIGHT hand, out to the side with clear silhouette; LEFT hand open for balance. The claw catches and tears the trailing lower coat tail, leaving a clearly missing triangular section. Ground around the contact is broad pale planes, just a few displaced chips. Tendon partly hidden under claw, not cut yet.

entries.title: Make it lift
entries.caption: She draws the claw away and cuts what holds the monster upright.
entries.brief: Mael lunges beneath the lifted creature wrist as it reaches again for her torn coat. Her RIGHT-hand estoc slices the now-exposed taut black shadow-tendon across the bright stone band. Show two separated black ends with a clean pale gap at the blade and the ivory supporting joint folding sideways as the load releases; lowered mask follows the body. Mael's legs separate cleanly and her torn coat tail persists. A crimson-thin blade accent only, no flesh injury. One sharp action with a visibly changed support.

entries.title: The mask touches stone
entries.caption: The rule works. The dark doorway suggests this was only one of them.
entries.brief: The same creature's ivory mask now rests on the pale floor in foreground, black petal body slumped behind, its supporting limb bent and severed dark tendon ends apart. Mael stands beyond the mask, breathing hard with estoc lowered in RIGHT hand; torn coat tail remains. Her expression mixes relief with fascination. A distant dark doorway holds a faint second petal silhouette as a restrained future threat, not another detailed monster. Dry quiet floor, elegant broad blacks.

entries.title: Hold the charge
entries.caption: The cleaver takes the load, but his boots must hold it.
entries.brief: Orren braces on the dry crossing with both boots grounded and both hands on the cleaver. The blade's broad flat meets the charging boar's tusk base/jaw; shoulders compress and coat pulls backward. The boar's hind legs drive into the charge while forelegs bear weight; show its complete body and four coherent legs. Canal edge clearly RIGHT, large arches behind. Tension and weight before any displacement, not an airborne knockback.

power.name: Burden Transfer
power.description: The cleaver redirects load through a braced stance; a short step changes the lever arm.
power.limitation: A sliding boot breaks the brace and sends the load into the fighter's arm.
power.growth: Transfer force through shorter, moving stances rather than relying on a planted hold.

entries.title: The brace breaks
entries.caption: The beast turns the load sideways and breaks his planted stance.
entries.brief: The boar twists its armored head across the trapped broad blade. Orren's torso is dragged sideways, his near boot sliding toward the visible canal edge at lower RIGHT. His LEFT forearm guard cracks under the lever load, jaw clenched, both hands still gripping the same long hilt. Keep beast jaw, tusk, blade and fighter arms readable in close proximity; the camera can crop rear body intentionally. No dust wall hiding the sliding foot.

entries.title: Step inside the weight
entries.caption: He shortens the lever and makes the turning beast carry its own fall.
entries.brief: Orren has stepped inward under the boar's near jaw, away from the canal. His shoulder and two-handed cleaver form a short lever beneath the jaw while his inside boot plants close to the beast. The boar rolls toward its near shoulder, forelegs folding against the crossing and hind feet pivoting; an immense torso falling onto its flank rather than launching into air. Dent the near copper shoulder plate where it strikes stone. Keep Orren separate from beast anatomy, his cracked LEFT guard visible, clear lever/torso/ground relationships.

entries.title: Heavy breathing
entries.caption: The beast is down. His arm paid for the failed brace.
entries.brief: The boar lies on its flank beside the canal, four limbs in a coherent resting arrangement, near shoulder plate visibly dented, green jaw grille venting one broad soft breath. Orren sits on the dry ground with cleaver across his thighs, supporting his cracked LEFT forearm guard with his RIGHT hand. Exhausted grin rather than flexing. Show distance from canal, the same cream arches and orange trees, minimal particles and broad matte ground.

entries.title: Leave a second beat
entries.caption: The first hit leaves a pulse waiting in his guard.
entries.brief: Tavi drives the orange face of her hammer into Bellguard's raised forearm guard. He bends his knees and absorbs the blow rather than lifting off the ground. A single broad orange ring remains at the hammer/guard contact, with a small chip knocked from the hammer's orange face. Tavi's grin is fierce, clear two-hand grip, separate body silhouettes, windmills grouped far behind. One compact impact accent only.

power.name: Second Beat
power.description: One struck surface receives a delayed second impulse, marked by a broad orange ring.
power.limitation: The delay leaves time for an enemy counter; Tavi must remain close enough to exploit the opening.
power.growth: Vary the delay to break an opponent's rhythm or use the pulse defensively.

entries.title: He answers between beats
entries.caption: He counters during the delay. She has to survive the gap.
entries.brief: Bellguard throws his OTHER fist across Tavi's face while the marked forearm is still raised behind. Tavi folds low and twists through the narrow gap, cheek and blond hair almost brushing the huge passing gauntlet; delighted surprise changes to concentration. Her hammer stays in both hands with its head trailing low, chipped orange face visible. Show a few long directional strokes and broad sky; focus on the threatening gap and expressive faces/helmet. No extra limbs or invisible torso.

entries.title: Open the guard, take the knee
entries.caption: The delayed pulse opens his upper guard as she takes away his stance.
entries.brief: The broad orange ring on Bellguard's raised forearm bursts as one clean graphic pulse, forcing that arm outward and twisting his shoulders. At the same instant Tavi pivots very low, both hands on the continuous turquoise shaft sweeping its lower length behind his near knee. His knee buckles and torso rotates, opposite boot still scraping the ground; full separate readable legs. Tavi's face shows timing and effort. Hammer head and hands remain distinct, no airborne body. Windmills reduced to quiet background shapes.

entries.title: A laugh between breaths
entries.caption: The second hit wins a moment, not an effortless victory.
entries.brief: Bellguard sits heavily on the pale arena floor, one knee bent, other leg extended, armor intact but dusty, orange pulse completely gone. Tavi kneels a pace away leaning on her hammer's intact shaft, chipped orange face resting on the ground. She is breathless and laughing; he tilts his helmet at her with reluctant respect. Adult proportions and readable hands. No sparks, no floating rubble, broad warm sky and a distant windmill.

entries.title: A head-on answer
entries.caption: She can turn what touches the spearhead.
entries.brief: Ilvan stands LEFT before the sunlit arch, palm sending a single orange fire pulse horizontally toward Sera at RIGHT beneath the red awning. Sera meets its leading edge with the bronze spearhead and diverts it upward in a short bright curve. Keep palm-source, incoming fire, exact bronze contact and diverted leading edge all visible, with both fighters clear. Two-handed spear grip and contrasting cool Sera/umber rival, no other soldiers.

power.limitation: The spear can redirect only what its head touches, leaving high-low feints dangerous.

entries.title: The low feint
entries.caption: He sends the next pulse underneath her recovery.
entries.brief: Ilvan's high pulse has faded; a newly committed low pulse skims toward Sera's waist from LEFT while her spearhead is still raised at upper RIGHT. She bends desperately away with a shocked focused face, two hands dragging the shaft down. The low flame catches the LOWER RED CAPE HEM and chars it in a broad dark ragged shape. Her body remains clear of the flame. Source palm visible small at far LEFT edge or depth, no disembodied magic. Floor is broad cream with one shadow.

One broad U-shaped return arc bends at that exact metal contact and travels LEFT back into Ilvan's casting forearm while the trailing incoming orange band still connects to his palm. Separate the outgoing high arc from the incoming low band with clear blue/cream negative space. Ilvan's shoulder folds and casting elbow bends sharply, one knee buckling; other arm's bronze shield stays separate. Sera's lower cape hem remains charred. Powerful selective white contact, no multicolored spark cloud.

sequences.title: The borrowed beat
sequences.contract: Riven is the same light-skinned adult man with silver swept hair, teal long combat coat, black armor and a single cyan-edged saber in his RIGHT hand. New rival Vey is a light-skinned adult woman about33, angular face, short black hair, ash-white fitted combat armor, short wine-red cape, a single long black-shaft hooked glaive held with both hands. They fight on a dry pale bridge terrace: tall arch at LEFT, low parapet and open sky at RIGHT, one dark banner behind the arch. Keep the fight axis and the same light direction across views, without identical cameras. Borrowed Beat stores a brief pulse only after Riven's metal blade contacts the enemy weapon; it must discharge through the next weapon contact and cannot heal injury. Riven's LEFT forearm armor is cracked by the counter in beat2 and remains cracked in3/4. Vey's glaive is intact until it is dislodged in3 and lies on the floor in4. No other combatants. New actions, no reuse of the old airborne-opponent composition.

sequences.title: What the shadow holds
sequences.contract: Mael is the same light-skinned adult woman about34 with platinum loose hair, severe appealing face, long black-and-bone tailored battle coat, silver ankle armor and one thin dark estoc with silver guard in her RIGHT hand. Same towering hollow-orchid creature: ivory pointed mask, layered black petal body, long jointed ivory supporting forelimbs with broad pointed finger-like claws, dark flexible connecting shadow-tendons. Preserve the first new frame's actual construction consistently, no anatomy roulette. Dry pale glasshouse arcade, upright light ribs recede to a dark doorway at LEFT and a bright opening at RIGHT; foliage grouped into large masses. Its rule: the creature's hard body ignores shallow blade contact, but the black shadow-tendon stretched across lit ground bears its weight and can be severed by Mael's estoc. The creature counters by covering that tendon with its lifted broad claw. Mael must lure that claw off the ground to expose the tendon. Beat2 tears the tail of her coat; preserve that specific tear in3/4. Cut only the black shadow, not flesh: no blood. Same sophisticated monochrome fashion-horror painting, quiet surfaces, beautiful face. Not a generic anime repaint.

sequences.title: Inside the turning weight
sequences.contract: Orren is the same light-skinned stocky muscular adult man about41, red hair with gray at temples, square face, olive battle coat, cream pauldrons, rust forearm armor and a single huge steel combat cleaver with long dark hilt held in both hands. Same copper-orange armored iron boar, green jaw grille, large tusks and four sturdy jointed legs. Full coherent beast construction; keep shape established in the first new image. Dry ochre canal crossing under simple cream aqueduct arches; canal edge is RIGHT, orange trees grouped far LEFT. Clear large matte ground planes, opaque intentional brushwork. Burden Transfer lets the cleaver transmit the boar's force into Orren's stance only while both boots are braced; he cannot hold an unlimited charge. Beat2 cracks his LEFT forearm armor and forces his near boot toward the canal edge. He must step inside the turn and change leverage, not overpower a larger beast by hovering. Beat3 dents the boar's near shoulder plate; preserve dent in4. No flying enemy as the solution.

sequences.title: The second beat
sequences.contract: Tavi is the same light-skinned muscular adult woman about29 with short blond quiff, expressive eyebrows, turquoise sleeveless battle top, olive cropped trousers, orange sash, cream/orange boots and one turquoise-shaft combat hammer with a large cream head and orange striking face. Opponent Bellguard is a much larger adult in charcoal-purple full armor, closed hornless helmet with warm eye slit, red waistcloth and heavy gauntlets, empty hands. Simple dry pale arena surrounded by distant windmills, low wall behind, no rubble carpet. Preserve elastic outlined cartoon drawing and broad clean color shapes rather than generic glossy fantasy. Her first hammer hit leaves ONE broad orange ring on his raised forearm guard; the ring indicates one delayed secondary impulse. He counterpunches before it releases; she must evade. In beat3 the ring releases, his guard flies OPEN while she sweeps his knee with the hammer's long shaft; his body twists and loses stance rather than floating upward. Orange ring absent in4. Keep adults, strong hands and distinct bent limbs. Final Tavi has a chipped orange hammer face from beat1, intact continuous shaft. Fixed anatomical sides: Bellguard LEFT forearm carries the orange ring; his RIGHT fist counterpunches. Tavi sweeps behind Bellguard RIGHT knee with direct visible shaft contact. Keep these sides across camera changes.

sequences.title: The pulse that cannot return
sequences.contract: Sera is the same light-skinned adult woman about35, long black braid, cobalt-and-cream armor, flowing red cape, bronze greaves, one long dark shaft spear with a simple bronze angular head held with two hands. New rival Ilvan is a light-skinned adult man about40 with shaved head, short black beard, burnt-umber/red battle mantle, bronze forearm guards, one empty casting palm and a broad bronze shield on the other arm. Dry cream stepped dueling court, plain sunlit arch LEFT behind Ilvan, a long red awning RIGHT behind Sera. Warm outlined painted drawing, rich but broad color masses, matte paving. Ilvan emits a committed orange fire pulse from his open palm; once released its front cannot be recalled for a heartbeat. Sera can bend a pulse only where it physically meets her bronze spearhead; no remote reflection. Ilvan feints high, then fires low while her point is raised. The low pulse scorches the LOWER RED CAPE HEM inbeat2, remains visibly charred in3/4. Inbeat3 she drops her point into that low pulse and turns its leading arc back into his casting forearm before he can recall it; his casting shoulder folds, shield remains on the other arm, no gore. Clearly show incoming path, bronze contact and returning path without particle storms. No extra shield-line army. The low pulse in beat2 catches only the trailing cape tip as Sera shifts; its leading front remains within reach of her lowering spear, not already behind her. Beat3 has a lower incoming lane and an upper returning lane, meeting at the rightmost bend on the bronze spearhead.

acceptance.owner_preferences: No new votes inferred from global enthusiasm. User endorses current approach; cast and canon remain provisional.
acceptance.review: Actual native and uninterrupted phone reading; independent pre-output rubric; record semantic failures and disagreements.
acceptance.finishing: Only observed surface noise warrants one source-only finish. Structural repair separate. No beauty padding.
acceptance.input_boundary: Only original project assets to generator. User screenshot and published excerpts are local viewing/research inputs, never generator inputs.
acceptance.context: Five independent provisional four-beat encounters, not one chronology spanning incompatible drawing worlds. Radical alternates are explicitly linked, not extra story beats.
